==Acquisition==
'''[[Skill quest]]s'''
*[[The Cipher of Lyssa]] ([[Tarnished Haven]])

== Notes ==

* Technobabble interrupt targets casting spells, an inherent effect of applying the Dazed condition.
* To Daze a boss, cast it on an adjacent foe.
** This skill will apply Dazed if the target is a [[boss-like foe]], such as the [[Apocrypha]] or the [[Undead Lich]]. 

{{anomaly|Exception: this skill will not daze [[Murakai, Lady of the Night|Murakai, Lady of the Night]], a boss-like foe.}}

{{anomaly|Technobabble's damage [[Armor-ignoring damage|respects armor]], even though it deals untyped damage.}}

== Trivia ==
* Is a reference to [[w:Technobabble|technobabble]] ([http://wiki.guildwars.com/index.php?title=User_talk:Emily_Diehl/Trivia_archive_2&oldid=571864#Technobabble_trivia_.3F source]), which refers to meaningless phrases that sound scientific and also to overly technical jargon that is used to intentionally obscure meaning to the uninitiated.
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
